steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Lemma practically lives at the library. Naturally, we got to know each other pretty well after a while.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: She's especially into the history of science. At one point, she even dreamed of writing her own book titled DisCity's Golden Age of Science. Too bad research ended up eating all her time, so... she's been pinning her hopes on Professor Celine to carry the torch instead.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see.
So that's who Lemma was speaking to earlier. A scientist and a humanities professor... an unexpected pairing indeed.
That reminds you. You turn your gaze to Linda.
The word "dissertation" makes her face seize up, as though she's on the verge of a cardiac episode.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Well... I've only just passed the internal review. I was a wreck during the defense. You know, the history department hasn't produced a single PhD in forever. All my classmates, seniors, juniors... they've all jumped ship. Some bailed right after undergrad and went straight into law, finance, that sort of thing.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: I quite literally don't have a single peer I can turn to for advice. And whenever I ask my professor, all I get is, "It's great, don't worry. Well-written. Start thinking about publication." Is that not terrifying?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That sounds about right. I read through your dissertation, you know. Your account of the West District was thorough and completely objective. My friends and I were genuinely moved by it.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: I... I'll keep doing my best.

Linda offers a shy smile. A sense of deep and profound ease settles over you. After long stretches of work, you always find yourself drawn to places like this, somewhere to shake off the weariness and restore the spirit.
Which reminds you that there's another lively soul here you're particularly keen to track down and amuse yourself with.
A few steps more, around the corner, and you locate one of the study rooms. You push the door open.
The blonde genius scientist very nearly leaps clean out of her skin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Didn't you say you were worried about me? You've been sneaking glances through the window this whole time, surely you didn't think I wouldn't notice? Come on, since I'm here, let's hang out.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: No... I've got your number now. You're a cunning old fox, just like her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Celine mentioned you're into the history of science. Especially the expedition. Lucky for you, I happen to be an expert. You can ask me anything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm out on missions every Illusory Moon cycle. I'd say I know quite a few things.
She shoots you a glare.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: No thanks. I've already read all your mission reports.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The esteemed EDGE-07, keeping tabs on a humble MBCC Chief's field operations? Is that part of the fangirl routine too?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: That was work! WORK! Rational data collection! You... you're impossible—!
There, there. You've squeezed enough entertainment out of this. Push any further and she'll actually bolt. You dial it back, settle into the seat beside her, voice softening.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Unusual idols. I'm a fan of theirs too, actually. What is it you like about them? The "talent" part?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Of course! A brilliant mind is one in a million, humanity's rarest resource. Genuinely priceless. We can excel at anything we set our minds to, far beyond what ordinary people can manage. That deserves admiration. We have every right to take pride in that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pfft. You say that, but I've actually met expedition members. None of them were half as cocky as you.
She shoots you another death stare, though this time she keeps a lid on it.
Lemma then drops her gaze, fidgeting with the book in her hands. Only now do you get a clear look—there, on the cover, is a handwritten title that reads DisCity's Golden Age of Science.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...That's exactly why I think those scientists, the true geniuses, were the greatest people in the world.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: They were brilliant enough to go into politics, build business empires, or trade stocks to amass a fortune. Those with true intellect see wider, further, and deeper than anyone else. Countless paths naturally open up before them. No matter what they choose, they are bound to succeed.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: But instead, they picked the loneliest road. Fields humanity doesn't even understand yet. They chose the most dangerous, most grueling, most uncertain place, and challenged the unknown there. As well as... themselves.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Science is the cruelest battlefield. You walk a narrow path along a lonely peak, raising your torch to light up the darkness, and time after time, all it shows you is your own failure and ignorance.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Doubt, arrogance, cowardice, anxiety... Any one of them can kick you straight into the abyss. There, no one will stand beside you. Even if you keep going, you'll never know whether you're simply a fool—too stubborn to realize you've been walking the wrong path all along.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Yet they kept walking. To this day, the theories they built serve as torches for those who follow. Their spirit, precious as gold, still guides us forward. The road they once walked alone has become a glorious legacy. Now it's been passed down into my hands. I love it. I've always loved it.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I... want to become someone like them.
Her wish comes out as a whisper, like a stone dropped into a lake.
You can't quite name the feeling stirring within your chest. Yet before you realize it, the question has already left your lips.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Scared of what?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of those ruthless Undergrounders. Of... the Black Rings, the catastrophe itself. You...
...You're just a kid. You could get killed at any moment, like what almost happened back there.
She lets out a soft, amused laugh, that proud, self-satisfied look of hers slipping back into place along with it.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Who do you think we are? We're scientists! Ignorance is way scarier than death to us!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Besides, I'm EDGE-07. Best of the new generation, a certified super genius. Even if my tech falls into the wrong hands, I'll outmatch them in theory, in calculations, in pure intellect.
She tilts her head back, hands planted on her hips. It's a mirror image of Summer's pose, lacking only a foot braced triumphantly upon the desk.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: And if science alone can't hold back the catastrophe, then I'll stand on the front line myself. I'll face what ordinary people are too scared to face in their stead. I'll conquer that fear. I'll tear the unknown wide open for all of humanity. I've even got a whole team with me!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: That's my mission as Lemma. It's what a true genius should... no, must do.
Another stone dropped into the water.
Lemma turns to face you, and something within her eyes completely changes.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: So stop being so spineless, and stop talking about shutting down BR-003 already. We have to <size=45>face it</size>. This is our best shot at cracking the Black Rings. You did pretty well last time, didn't you? Fight on, don't chicken out!

Water leaps into the air in glittering droplets, and the sun, passing through pane after pane, finds its way at last to her golden hair. You simply watch, your gaze lingering far longer than you intended.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I have to say, you really are a little like them.
You reach out and ruffle her hair.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pushing yourself this hard... You sure you're not going bald yet? Let me check.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: !@#$%^&!! Ugh, don't touch my hair!! You're so annoying!

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Oh! Teacher—
At the sound of Linda's voice, Lemma bolts upright. Her eyes light up, and she's already poised to lunge toward the door.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Professor Celine! Uh...
But it's someone else who walks through that door.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: So I hear DisCity's finest student is in the house! Let me have a look. Set a good example for my wayward student here. You want your name in the history books too, do you? Splendid! Let this great poet compose an ode to a great scientist!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Aaahhh—!!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Quit scaring the kid. And who are you calling wayward?
[Small CG: Everyone has gathered]

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, you're carrying so many books... Are you actually going to read all of them?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What, I'm just looking at the pictures. I'll flip through them real fast! I wanna learn stuff too, okay? Crache feels the same, right?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Besides, don't we have a little young lady at home who can tutor me?

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: But Hella, these are all doctoral dissertations... Black Ring research and things like that... I can't understand them either... Oh, there's a famous scientist right beside you. Maybe she could—

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Excuse me?! D-don't come any closer! Don't you dare infect me with your dumbness—

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Lemma, that's totally unscientific! Intelligence doesn't spread through cell contact, you know? Guess you didn't even need to be infected——

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: SUMMER!!!

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Slow down, slow down! This is a library. Please be quiet—

The room swells with more and more people, until it seems it can hold no more. At last, you find a gap and slip away, leaving the warmth of the crowd behind. You climb the stairs alone and find Celine in another small room.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It might be faint, but the shackles can sense registered Sinners, Professor. I know where to find you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why hide away up here? Were we too much?

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Not at all. After my trip to the West District, and after meeting with you, I've been full of new ideas for my research. And besides...

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: As you might be aware, Linda's been on my case. I really do need to catch up.
You observe her perfectly unruffled expression and think to yourself: Sure, but the 8 whole camera feeds on the screen next to you say otherwise. You've been watching the whole time.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: On top of that, you've finally made genuine contact with EDGE-07. You should take the time to connect. Your relationship was rather strained before, after all—with all those misunderstandings between you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Those stories about the scientists... you're the one who told them to her, aren't you? You made them sound so romantic. I bet you'd be able to write the most beautiful fairy tales.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can hardly imagine someone so pure-hearted coming out of a place like the Ring Research Institute otherwise.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's lucky to have a teacher like you.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: You're flattering me again.

You stepped willingly into United University, entered the Ring Research Institute, and boarded the Observation Hub, all for BR-003. So many faces, so many things. You witnessed minds that should have remained incorruptible eroded one after another, as halls meant to inspire reverence crumbled piece by piece.
And yet, just moments ago, in that child, all the stifling weight you had carried was swept clean away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Call us naive, but we do want to believe in genius, in wisdom, and in science. Rationality should be the one thing that holds in the face of Mania. I'd rather put my faith in that than spend every day being suspicious, wondering if it's all just a cover for one ugly secret after another.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, I can finally believe in some of those people.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you, Professor. You gave that young scientist a dream she can keep clean.
Her smile remains, but there's something else woven through it now, an emotion you cannot quite decipher.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: I don't deserve that honor, Chief. Lemma's real teachers are the pioneers who came before, generation after generation, and that young, romantic heart of hers, so full of fire.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: I'm only the city's chronicler. A page in a book, if you will. People come with their questions, and I turn to the page they're searching for. That's all. Human history leads them forward on its own.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: The stars shine brightly above. The silent river below merely traces their reflection.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: When I look at Lemma, I see those scientists I've studied but never known brought to life. That's reward enough for me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Preserving the truth. Letting people see history. That's always been the honor of the page.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Though you've done a little more than that. You shifted the current when no one was watching and brought scattered stars together in the same water.
You gesture toward the screen, and at that, she smiles.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Then tell me. You, who have turned the pages and stepped into the current, who now shine within it yourself... which path will you walk?
You take a deep breath.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My enemy isn't the voices that oppose me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And my goal isn't just to wipe out a single Black Ring.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My enemy is Mania itself. I want to stop it from spreading, for good. The Sillage Society. The Underground. The Black Rings. And the shadows that have sunk their roots into this city, rotting it from the inside out. I need to find a way to tear them out completely.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How much can history show me? I'll trade everything I have.
She takes it in, and a sigh escapes her.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: You've chosen quite the question. It's not one I can answer here and now.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Public records on the Sillage Society are sparse. I'll need to investigate further, verify what I find... It will take time. Should I make any progress, I'll reach out through Terminal 0490.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: That said, even with Speaker Max King's backing, the 9th Agency's expertise, and so many other departments at your disposal... you still came to me. A scholar.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Chief... what is it you're really hoping to get from me?
Your gazes meet and hold.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Every era has its fog. I need you to give me eyes that can see through it. I need you to tell me—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Their origins</color>, the <color=#fb9259>truth</color>, and their <color=#fb9259>purpose</color>.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Tell me what the Underground really is. And where I might find a way in.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: ...Even EDGE has struggled to uncover it. It's buried so very deep, and extremely dangerous... But I will find the answers.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Professor...

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: And once I do, what will you give me in return?

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Your stories, the ones you're living now and the ones still to come... that won't be nearly enough.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Then take my past as well.
I have nothing more to give.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: I'm only joking.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Relax. The terms of our trade are much simpler than that. I'd like you to let Linda join you for some of your upcoming operations. Within the bounds of your security clearance, of course.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: She's submitted her thesis, yes, but this student of mine still has a long road ahead. I alone can only do so much, and I'll be tied up with personal research for the foreseeable future. I won't have the time she needs. You, on the other hand, can offer her a learning opportunity.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: So, may I entrust her fieldwork to you, Chief?
The request is surprising, though not something you can reasonably decline.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've got a lot in motion myself, and plenty of people to reach out to. Maybe this time, I'll actually change something.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Once it's done, I'll come back and fill you in. And then...
You pause for a moment, then continue.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's a lot more I want to tell you. It won't exactly be lighthearted, though.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So for now, let's just take this moment while it's here.

You offer her your hand. Celine studies you for a long moment, and then, at last, a smile graces her lips as she accepts. Together, you step out of the room and make your way toward the gathering crowd.
[Happy Crowd CG for 2s]
These are chaotic times. And yet, beyond all the secrets lurking within the shadows, happiness and hope are no less true.
Before they are swallowed by the flood, they, too, deserve to be preserved in the annals of history.
[Scene Change] Nighttime
[Lemma and Chief character portraits with dark gradient, positioned left and right]

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...Huh? You mean...
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...So that's where things stand. Thank you for your help. Now that I've seen it all firsthand, I finally know who my enemy is and what I'm really after.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: EDGE-07 isn't my enemy. If anything, I need her as an ally.
A long, contemplative silence stretches from the other end of the line. Then, at last, a reply comes.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: ...So that's your decision. To end our cooperation and side with that genius instead.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: And you actually called to tell me yourself... I didn't expect such honesty from you, Chief.

options: And are you really as cunning as you make yourself out to be, Director?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you truly wanted her gone, no matter the cost, you could've just let her die when the Hub was attacked. But you didn't. You wanted her to live.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Get away from there!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Something's felt off since the day I met you two. What even is your relationship with her? Why push her out of her seat? What do you actually want with the EDGE-07 seat? And the one you're trying to defeat... is it really Lemma?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Talk to me, Isomer. I've found my path, but where does yours lead?
You hear something similar to laughter from the other end of the line.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}. You've chosen her, which makes us opponents now.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I'm not that naive.
The familiar oppressive weight stirs once more. Yes, this is what it means to stand before her. This time, though, you will not retreat.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Alright. No more delusions, then. I'll ask you something practical instead.

options: How did the Underground get into BR-003?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How did they keep pace with the research so flawlessly? How do they know the technical specs so well? Why did it happen right when she was at her weakest? And why did they want to take her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How were you planning to bring down EDGE-07 originally? Who were you working with before you came to me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Choose your words carefully, Director. Your answer will decide whether I mark you as an <color=#fb9259>enemy</color>. So be very careful.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: ...Heh.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I'll be ready.
She refuses to give you a direct answer, right up to the bitter end.

The call ends. You open the door to find Schorl waiting outside. The last battle left its surface scarred in many places, yet you refused a replacement, opting for maintenance only. The little triangle tried to reason with you, explaining that the programs you know would simply transfer as data to any new unit.
But seeing how adamant you remained, it offered no further objection.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Shall I contact EDGE and request another proposal review?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. BR-003 was attacked. An Underground Sage made a move. On top of that, Lemma pulled off a breakthrough... You saw it, right? When she got me out, she actually reverse-engineered an Underground fissure. If she can push past her limits and develop that further... she might just be able to drag the Underground into the light for us.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Too much has happened for us to just sit on our hands. I'm not going to ask for another review—I'm throwing out the old playbook.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll get a <color=#fb9259>new proposal</color> ready. Trust me on this... EDGE will approve it this time.
It rattles twice with a dry click. It's impossible to tell what that reaction means, not that it does anything to diminish your good mood.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's be bold for once. Put BR-003 to its best possible use. Let's see if we can smoke out our <color=#fb9259>real enemy</color>.
[Scene Change] Library, Night

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: He changed tactics without hesitation, choosing to partner with EDGE-07 and continue developing BR-003.
steps.female_content: She changed tactics without hesitation, choosing to partner with EDGE-07 and continue developing BR-003.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Does that surprise you? Even a little?
Deep among the bookshelves, cloaked in shadow, a Schorl turns slowly. Faint threads of data-light glimmer across its polished surface.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It was one of the calculated possibilities. Additionally, you should be well aware that I don't experience emotions like surprise.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Is that so? I thought it might please you.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Though I can tell you've already flagged the outcome as positive. You approve of the Chief's decision.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Why not come out and meet him then? He's right here. You could join the fun. Lemma would be thrilled to see you, too.
steps.female_content: Why not come out and meet her then? She's right here. You could join the fun. Lemma would be thrilled to see you, too.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You do enjoy asking questions like this.
The Schorl severs the connection and rises slowly now that its task is complete. It drifts upward before gliding out of the storage area.
Behind it, a figure in white follows, stepping forth from the shadows.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: Meeting ${PlayerName} under these circumstances would only introduce unnecessary variables. There's also a non-zero probability that Lemma, upon seeing what I actually am, would experience disappointment. That could impact efficiency. I see no clear benefit in your suggestion.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: You know why I'm here. It is not to build relationships or maintain them.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: "It's to synchronize data—"

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Relax. It was a joke. You should be well aware that we humans enjoy those. You passed the test, my poor old friend.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Well then, the library's all yours. Take your time. I have matters to attend to, so I'll be off. You both asked me to dig into the same thing, and my research has reached a rather critical juncture. Busy days, I tell you.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: Keep yourself safe, Professor Fabius. You have been making rather... aggressive moves lately. You've already incurred additional risk. Be cautious.
Celine pauses mid-step and turns. How unexpected that the very personification of rationality would deliver a warning meant for another.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: ...Right back at you, sir. That little triangle of yours might misdiagnose words like that as residual sentiment. Don't let it think you've started caring about outsiders.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: But don't worry. A chronicle that's survived this long won't break so easily. Not on my watch.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: ...I still have empty pages to fill.
With that, she descends the long stairs, disappearing into the city's sprawling dark.
